subject.title: fix: add exact and prefix skill search modes

question: Should ClawHub accept bounded `mode=prefix|exact` on `/api/v1/search` plus `clawhub search --prefix/--exact` as the stable registry-discovery surface for the linked issue?
rationale: The PR adds a public CLI/API contract and caps list-style results at 200, while the linked request includes complete enumeration/counting workflows that may need cursor pagination.

options.title: Accept bounded search modes
options.body: Merge this direction after docs and real behavior proof if a bounded exact/prefix search mode is the intended first registry-discovery contract.

options.title: Require pageable registry listing
options.body: Ask for `/api/v1/skills` filters or a dedicated list mode with cursor pagination if complete namespace enumeration and counting are required.

options.title: Keep ranked search unchanged
options.body: Decline the public mode expansion and leave the linked issue open for a different API/CLI discovery design.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded search modes
recommendation.body: Merge this direction after docs and real behavior proof if a bounded exact/prefix search mode is the intended first registry-discovery contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the requested reviewer and the strongest current-history owner for the affected CLI/API/search paths.
